none: The job has no reason stored.
unknown: The stored reason is not one of the known words.
http_N: The job's page answered with an HTTP error (the number replaces N).
Retried by the daily slot; 403 and 429 back off.
link_mismatch: The page at the link is not this job.
Retried once with the ATS reader, then held.
no_job_id: The link names no job id, so the vacancy cannot be proven.
Retried; held if it stays unproven.
listing_url: The link is a list of jobs, not one job.
Retried; held if it stays a list.
jd_thin: The description is too short to judge.
Waits for the daily reset; a better page would clear it.
jd_template: The description is only the site's boilerplate.
jd_listing: The description is a list of other jobs.
description_empty_tf: The page and the TinyFish read both gave no description.
hold_expired: The job sat on hold past the limit and was excluded.
recovery_retry: The job was released from hold for another try.
unresolved_after_recovery: The link stayed unresolved after the recovery try.
lane_exclude: The lane policy excluded the job.
None; a policy change can requeue it.
screen_pay: The posted pay is below the floor.
in_ledger: A page for this job already exists in the Ledger.
same_opening: Another job is the same opening.
repost: The job is a repost of an earlier one.
repost_ambiguous: Two earlier jobs could be the original.
Resolve by hand if it matters.
dup_other_source: Another source already has this job.
dup_of_final_url: Another job has the same final link.
Fit_N_below_N: Fit scored the job below a floor (the numbers replace N).
audit_jd_thin: The precision audit found the description too thin.
audit_jd_template: The precision audit found only boilerplate.
audit_jd_listing: The precision audit found a list of jobs.
audit_url_listing_url: The precision audit found the link is a list of jobs.
audit_url_no_job_id: The precision audit found no job id in the link.
audit_url_root: The precision audit found the link is only a site root.
audit_url_workable_no_account: A Workable link without the account name.
no_match_ambiguous+no_fit: More than one board matched and Fit could not decide.
no_match_ambiguous+no_result: More than one board matched and the search found nothing.
no_match_no_board+no_fit: No board matched and Fit could not decide.
no_match_no_board+no_result: No board matched and the search found nothing.
no_match_no_title+no_fit: No title matched and Fit could not decide.
no_match_no_title+no_result: No title matched and the search found nothing.
excluded_fit: The precision audit excluded the job on Fit.
None; the audit can revive it.
released_keep_list: A keep-list role was released back to READY.
released_ledger: A job was released because its Ledger page is gone.
requeued_age: A stale job was requeued after its age rule changed.
requeued_direct: A job was requeued for a direct-link read.
requeued_fit: A job was requeued after Fit changed.
requeued_floor: A job was requeued after the Fit floor changed.
requeued_linkedin: A LinkedIn job was requeued for another read.
retired_by_jim: Retired by hand on Jim's instruction.
title_watch_unseen: The title watch no longer sees the role on the company's site.
route_negative: The route for this role is negative.
route_unresolved: The route for this role is unresolved.
fit_below_review_floor: Fit is below the Review floor.
fit_below_near_miss_with_open_question: Fit is a near miss with an open question.
fit_below_admit_floor: Fit is below the Admit floor, so the job is Review at best.
fit_below_admit_floor_keep_list: Fit is below the Admit floor, on the keep list.
fit_unscorable: Fit could not score the job.
thin_description: The description is too short to judge; Review from the apply link.
excluded_private_rule: A private rule excluded the job (the rule's text is never printed).
pay_below_floor: Explicit pay is below the floor.
title_only: Found by title search; the description was not read.
market_mismatch: The market is not the lane's market.
market_not_shown: The market is not shown to be the lane's market.
not_a_vacancy: Not a vacancy: an open application.
not_in_london: The role is not in London.
older_than_max_age: The posting is older than the maximum age.
posting_date_future: The posting date is in the future.
